def normalise(value):
    text = str(value if value is not None else "").lower().replace("_", " ")
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", text)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()


def phrase_in(text, phrase):
    p = normalise(phrase)
    if not p:
        return False
    padded = f" {text} "
    if " " in p:
        return f" {p} " in padded
    if len(p) >= 5:
        return p in text
    return re.search(r"\b" + re.escape(p) + r"\b", text) is not None


def load_csv(path):
    if not path or not path.exists():
        return [], []
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
        sample = f.read(4096)
        f.seek(0)
        try:
            dialect = csv.Sniffer().sniff(sample, delimiters=",;\t|")
        except Exception:
            dialect = csv.excel
        reader = csv.DictReader(f, dialect=dialect)
        rows = [dict(row) for row in reader]
        return rows, list(reader.fieldnames or [])


def find_key(headers, exact=(), contains_any=(), contains_all=()):
    normed = [(h, normalise(h)) for h in headers]
    exact_normed = tuple(normalise(e) for e in exact)
    for h, n in normed:
        if n in exact_normed:
            return h
    if contains_all:
        for h, n in normed:
            if all(term in n for term in contains_all):
                return h
    if contains_any:
        for h, n in normed:
            if any(term in n for term in contains_any):
                return h
    return None

    if not key:
        return ""
    value = row.get(key, "")
    return "" if value is None else str(value).strip()

    matches = {}

        score = 0.0
        matched = []
        for keyword, weight in keywords:
            if phrase_in(text, keyword):
                score += weight
                matched.append(keyword)
        scores[theme] = score
        matches[theme] = matched
    return scores, matches


def map_source_theme(raw_theme):
    t = normalise(raw_theme)

        return None

    if any(phrase_in(t, k) for k in (
        "population", "density", "demograph", "land use",
        "sprawl", "settlement",
    )):
        return "population_density"
    if any(phrase_in(t, k) for k in (
        "environment", "climate", "air", "green", "energy",
        "waste", "water", "noise", "biodiversity", "pollution", "emission",
    )):

        "crime", "education", "service", "amenity", "wellbeing",
        "inclusion", "income", "employment",
    )):

    return None

        return lookup

        meta_headers,
        exact=("table_id", "table_code", "dataset_id", "dataset_code", "id", "code", "table"),
        contains_all=("table", "id"),
    )
    if not id_key and meta_headers:
        id_key = meta_headers[0]
    name_key = find_key(
        meta_headers,
        exact=("table_name", "title", "name", "label", "table_title"),
        contains_any=("name", "title", "label"),
    )
    desc_key = find_key(
        meta_headers,
        exact=("description", "metadata", "notes", "comment", "summary"),
        contains_any=("description", "detail", "note", "comment", "summary"),
    )
    for row in meta_rows:
        tid = get(row, id_key)
        if not tid:
            continue
        parts = [tid]
        for key in (name_key, desc_key):
            value = get(row, key)
            if value:
                parts.append(value)
        lookup[normalise(tid)] = " ".join(parts)
        lookup[tid.lower()] = " ".join(parts)
    return lookup


def expected_direction(candidate, theme):
    text = candidate["text"]

    negative_terms = (
        "air pollution", "pollut", "emission", "greenhouse gas", "co2",
        "carbon dioxide", "noise", "waste", "congestion", "traffic delay",
        "travel delay", "commute time", "journey time", "unemployment",

        "housing cost", "accident", "accidents", "fatal", "fatalities",

        "income", "employment", "education", "health", "safety",
        "quality of life", "well being", "wellbeing", "amenit", "service",
        "inclusion", "affordab",

        if phrase_in(text, term):

    for term in positive_terms:
        if phrase_in(text, term):

    if theme == "living_conditions":

    return "contextual"


def make_justification(candidate, theme):
    theme_label = theme.replace("_", " ")
    matched = candidate["matches"].get(theme, [])
    useful = []
    for term in matched:
        if term not in useful:
            useful.append(term)
        if len(useful) == 2:
            break
    if useful:
        if len(useful) == 1:
            return f"Measures {useful[0]} relevant to {theme_label}."
        return f"Captures {useful[0]} and {useful[1]} relevant to {theme_label}."
    fallback = {
        "mobility": "Relevant to urban transport, travel, and accessibility conditions.",
        "population_density": "Relevant to urban population concentration and land use.",
        "environment": "Relevant to environmental quality and climate pressures in cities.",
        "living_conditions": "Relevant to housing, services, safety, and wellbeing.",
    }
    return fallback[theme]

def find_input(base, filename):

    base = discover_base()
    desc_path = find_input(base, "indicator_descriptions.csv")

    rows, headers = load_csv(desc_path)

    name_key = find_key(
        headers,
        exact=(
            "indicator_name", "name", "title", "label", "indicator_title",
            "indicator_label",
        ),
        contains_any=("name", "title", "label"),
    )
    if not name_key:
        name_key = find_key(
            headers,
            exact=("description", "indicator_description", "definition"),
            contains_any=("description", "definition"),
        )

    desc_key = find_key(
        headers,
        exact=(
            "description", "indicator_description", "definition", "details",
            "notes", "comment", "summary",
        ),
        contains_any=("description", "definition", "detail", "note", "comment", "summary"),
    )

    theme_key = find_key(
        headers,
        exact=("theme", "topic", "domain", "category", "indicator_theme", "group"),
        contains_any=("theme", "topic", "domain", "category", "group"),
    )

    table_key = find_key(
        headers,
        exact=("table_id", "table_code", "dataset_id", "dataset_code", "table"),
        contains_all=("table", "id"),
    )
    if not table_key:
        table_key = find_key(
            headers,
            exact=("dataset", "table"),
            contains_any=("table", "dataset"),
        )

    candidates = []
    seen_ids = set()

    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
        indicator_id = get(row, id_key)
        if not indicator_id or indicator_id in seen_ids:
            continue

        indicator_name = get(row, name_key) or indicator_id
        description = get(row, desc_key)
        raw_theme = get(row, theme_key)

        table_id = get(row, table_key)
        meta_text = ""
        if table_id:
            meta_text = (
                meta_lookup.get(normalise(table_id), "")
                or meta_lookup.get(table_id.lower(), "")
            )

        combined = " ".join([
            indicator_id,
            indicator_name,
            description,
            raw_theme,
            meta_text,
        ])
        text = normalise(combined)
        scores, matches = score_text(text)

        source_theme = map_source_theme(raw_theme)
        if source_theme:
            scores[source_theme] += 4.0

        max_score = max(scores.values()) if scores else 0.0
        if max_score > 0:
            primary = max(scores, key=lambda t: (scores[t], -THEMES.index(t)))
        else:
            primary = source_theme if source_theme in THEMES else "living_conditions"

        candidates.append({
            "id": indicator_id,
            "name": indicator_name,
            "description": description,
            "raw_theme": raw_theme,
            "text": text,
            "scores": scores,
            "matches": matches,
            "primary": primary,
            "index": index,
        })
        seen_ids.add(indicator_id)

    selected = []
    selected_ids = set()

    def add_candidate(candidate, theme):
        if candidate["id"] in selected_ids:
            return False
        chosen = dict(candidate)
        chosen["selected_theme"] = theme
        selected.append(chosen)
        selected_ids.add(candidate["id"])
        return True

    def theme_sort_key(candidate, theme):
        return (
            candidate["scores"].get(theme, 0.0),
            1 if candidate["primary"] == theme else 0,
            sum(candidate["scores"].values()),
            -candidate["index"],
        )

    quotas = {
        "mobility": 3,
        "population_density": 2,
        "environment": 3,
        "living_conditions": 3,
    }

    for theme in THEMES:
        quota = quotas[theme]
        pool = [
            c for c in candidates
            if c["id"] not in selected_ids
            and (c["primary"] == theme or c["scores"].get(theme, 0.0) > 0)
        ]
        pool.sort(key=lambda c: theme_sort_key(c, theme), reverse=True)
        for candidate in pool[:quota]:
            add_candidate(candidate, theme)

    for theme in THEMES:
        if not any(c["selected_theme"] == theme for c in selected):
            pool = [c for c in candidates if c["id"] not in selected_ids]
            pool.sort(
                key=lambda c: (
                    c["scores"].get(theme, 0.0),
                    sum(c["scores"].values()),
                    -c["index"],
                ),
                reverse=True,
            )
            if pool:
                add_candidate(pool[0], theme)

    target_total = 12
    while len(selected) < target_total:
        pool = [c for c in candidates if c["id"] not in selected_ids]
        if not pool:
            break
        pool.sort(
            key=lambda c: (
                max(c["scores"].values()) if c["scores"] else 0.0,
                sum(c["scores"].values()),
                -c["index"],
            ),
            reverse=True,
        )
        candidate = pool[0]
        theme = candidate["primary"] if candidate["primary"] in THEMES else "living_conditions"
        add_candidate(candidate, theme)

    output_rows = []
    for candidate in selected[:15]:
        theme = candidate["selected_theme"]
        output_rows.append({
            "indicator_id": candidate["id"],
            "indicator_name": candidate["name"],
            "theme": theme,
            "justification": make_justification(candidate, theme),
            "expected_direction": expected_direction(candidate, theme),
        })

    out_path = base / "outputs" / "t01_selected_indicators.csv"
    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fieldnames = [
        "indicator_id",
        "indicator_name",
        "theme",
        "justification",
        "expected_direction",
    ]
    with open(out_path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(
            f,
            fieldnames=fieldnames,
            quoting=csv.QUOTE_MINIMAL,
            lineterminator="\r\n",
        )
        writer.writeheader()
        for row in output_rows:
            writer.writerow(row)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    padded = f" {text} "

    if len(p) >= 5:

    return re.search(r"\b" + re.escape(p) + r"\b", text) is not None
